video_title: Anthony Edwards & LaMelo Ball Got Minnesota Movin' DIFFERENT

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards and Rudy Gobert's chemistry in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: I think LaMelo is going to change Ant's ability to do everything out there.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: What have you made of Anthony Edwards out here? What do you think about Anthony Edwards and the Minnesota energy? We talked about it before. I think Rudy Gobert flew him to France. They really seem like they are locked in and having fun. I think LaMelo is going to change Ant's ability to do everything out there.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: They got traded. It went over.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The competitive nature of the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: I want the best of you so I can figure out how good I am.
quotes.quote: It is a question more than it is a statement. It is a challenge. It is like, I want the best of you so I can figure out how good I am. When you come in here, just know, come see me. I am likening it to Muhammad Ali. Muhammad Ali talks that way because I can only really be the best if I get the best out of you.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: The shift in player relationships across the league
quotes.excerpt: The league is different as far as everyone is cool now, which is fine.
quotes.quote: The league is different as far as everyone is cool now, which is fine. I do not want to sound like an old player, but everyone was not cool. Not that everyone had beef, but it just was not as buddy-buddy as it was back then. That energy takes me back to how we used to feel in the 2000s and the 90s. It is not sweet, we are not homies, we are ready to get down, and we can be cool after.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of unique playing styles in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Him and LaMelo, they are guys with unique games. They have their own style.
quotes.quote: Him and LaMelo, they are guys with unique games. They have their own style, their own way of playing. In a time now when a lot of people play the same, even the teams, which leads to the different champions we talk about. If everybody is just going to play the same, then the guys who have the best pieces for that style of game will win, which is why it is changing so much.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's potential to lead the league in assists
quotes.excerpt: I think LaMelo, if he wanted to, could lead the league in assists this year.
quotes.quote: I think LaMelo, if he wanted to, could lead the league in assists this year. I think he has got a lot of weapons over there. A lot of people say he has not really played meaningful basketball, obviously being in Charlotte. I think he is someone that can easily be a double-digit assist guy, and I think he is going to take so much pressure off of Ant.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of spacing on team playmaking
quotes.excerpt: Without Jrue and Rudy, the guys and Ant who started operating in the mid-range a lot too.
quotes.quote: Without Jrue and Rudy, the guys and Ant who started operating in the mid-range a lot too. They had three guys operating in certain places when Ant did not have it. The playmaking had to come in certain ways. Jrue is a good playmaker, but it just was not working with the spacing. Now you put the guy who does it out in space, so now the playmaking comes to guys who are catching and going with more space and not operating from these places where it is crowded.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.excerpt: I think this is a big year for him.
quotes.quote: I like Jonathan Kuminga playing the stretch four too, because he is tough. He can guard guys that are bigger than him. He has got an attitude, he has got an edge that the team needs. Kuminga, he is going to be a big, I think this is a big year for him. Obviously turning down his extension, going to Atlanta and then not necessarily working out, so they pretty much got him on a steal. He has the potential to be somebody in this league.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Simmons' injury and mental health challenges
quotes.excerpt: I want to send a shout out to Ben Simmons. Terrible luck.
quotes.quote: I want to send a shout out to Ben Simmons. Terrible luck, terrible luck, terrible luck. We are in such a weird space right now as media. I am kind of jumping ahead a little bit, but with the mental health being such a tough thing going on, and there are different examples going on on the football side where guys are setting things, and we will get into that a little bit later. For Ben Simmons to kind of mentally get himself back to where he needs to be, the motherfucker does not have to shoot. You cannot stop him getting downhill.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The unfair criticism of non-shooting players
quotes.excerpt: I hate that we did that to guys. Make them think that they have to prove their greatness.
quotes.quote: I hate that we did that to guys. Make them think that they have to prove their greatness by what people said that they cannot do. It goes back to playing the same, right? Because I do not shoot the three, you want to try to take away from if I am dominant. I think about it with Giannis all the time. Giannis went through this with the jumpshot. If you Shaq, be Shaq. It is fine. I do not have no problem. You are the new Shaq, be Shaq. Dominated that way, win the win the game. You say you want to win? Be the winning version of yourself.
